summary: Iteration 32: Tested Device Heartbeat, Ticket Auto-Ping/Escalation, Ping Settings Page, and Viewer Badge features. All backend tests pass (14/14). Frontend verified with screenshots showing all components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed route ordering issue: /devices/stale was after /devices/{device_id} causing 404. Moved stale route before dynamic route in devices.py
seed_data_creation: None needed - used existing devices and tickets
context_for_next_testing_agent: Device heartbeat (/api/devices/{id}/heartbeat), stale devices (/api/devices/stale), ticket ping settings (/api/settings/ticket-ping), team mappings (/api/settings/ticket-ping/team-mappings), escalation check (/api/tickets/check-escalations), ticket pick-up (/api/tickets/{id}/pick-up), ticket viewer tracking (/api/tickets/{id}/viewing, /api/tickets/active-viewers) all tested. Frontend Ticket Ping Settings page at /ticket-ping-settings verified with General Ping Settings, Category Team Mapping, SLA/Priority Team Mapping, and Escalation Contacts sections. Sidebar has Ping & Escalation link under System section.

device_heartbeat.notes: Accepts RMM agent fields (hostname, cpu_usage, memory_usage, disk_usage, os_name, ip_address, uptime_seconds, total_ram_gb, cpu_name, logged_in_user, antivirus_status) and maps to Device model

stale_devices.notes: Fixed route ordering issue - was returning 404 due to {device_id} matching first

ping_settings.notes: Returns enabled, ping_interval_minutes, escalation_timeout_hours, ping_on_create, ping_until_picked_up

ping_settings_page.notes: Has General Ping Settings, Category Team Mapping, SLA/Priority Team Mapping, Escalation Contacts sections with toggle switches and user selection

viewer_badge.notes: Cyan/purple gradient shimmer animation on viewed tickets with eye icon and viewer count
